AmaranthCanvas.usage: Sidebar, title-bar content background, playback background

AmaranthSurface.usage: Document, transcript, input and dialog surfaces

AmaranthAccent.usage: Selected tabs, source links, playback, focus and emphasized actions

AmaranthSelection.usage: Selected meeting row; retain an accent edge and selected state

AmaranthOnAccent.usage: Text/icons on a filled accent control

AmaranthDanger.usage: Destructive actions and recording dot with a text/shape state

transcript.sourceSelection: highlight passage and seek existing audio

recording.state: explicit record/stop label, timer, accessible value

layout.nativeWindow: Use the actual window title bar and standard window controls; preview traffic lights are illustrative.
